devHome.folder.label: dev-home folder
devHome.folder.help: Your dev-home folder: one that is already a dev-home. Until it's set, setup stops to ask for it.

updates.installAutomatically.label: Install dev-home-tools updates automatically
updates.installAutomatically.help: Whether a sync installs dev-home-tools updates as soon as it finds them.

updates.checkEveryHours.label: Check GitHub for dev-home-tools updates
updates.checkEveryHours.help: How often a sync checks GitHub for dev-home-tools updates. 0 checks every time.

devHome.checkEveryHours.label: Check GitHub for dev-home's changes
devHome.checkEveryHours.help: How often a sync checks GitHub for dev-home's changes, with one active copy, and for a plain /knowledge. 0 checks every time.

codex.setUp.label: Codex, in every Codex home
codex.setUp.help: Whether setup sets up Codex with dev-home's skills and rules in every Codex home on this PC, homes found later included. Every home reads the same skills, so it's all of them or none. Until it's answered, setup leaves Codex as it is.
